items.summary: Unit 13 Bilan: find the environment and weather word from each definition.
Present tense of -er verbs: rule box, match subjects to verbs, add endings.
Present of -er verbs: place verbs, negative contrasts, -ier/-uer/-ouer singular-plural switches.
Present of -ier verbs and -ger/-cer/-yer spelling changes: complete, underline, conjugate.
Place and conjugate -ger/-cer/-yer verbs; rule box on accent and doubling verbs.
Accent and doubled-consonant -er verbs: cross out wrong forms, add accents, conjugate.
Answer questions with accent-change verbs; conjugate English-derived verbs like spoiler, scanner.
Second-group -ir verbs: rule box, match subjects to forms, cross out wrong forms.
Second-group -ir verbs: complete sentences and switch between singular and plural.
Être, avoir, aller, faire: give subject pronouns and complete a street-survey dialogue.
End of survey dialogue; present people with être, avoir, faire, aller.
Answer with être/avoir/aller/faire; word search of conjugated third-group verbs.
Two-stem third-group verbs: match subjects, give pronouns, switch number, place verbs.
Two-stem verbs in -dre: singular/plural forms and sentence completion with conjugation.
Three-stem verbs: unscramble singular forms and supply plural subject pronouns.
